name: What is a load-bearing wall, and how can I identify one in my kitchen?
description: A load-bearing wall supports structural weight. Identifying one requires professional inspection to ensure your home's safety and integrity.

mainEntity.name: What is a load-bearing wall, and how can I identify one in my kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: A load-bearing wall supports the weight from upper floors or the roof, transferring it down to the foundation. Removing it requires structural reinforcement. While visible indicators like walls directly over a foundation or those supporting joists can suggest a load-bearing function, a definitive assessment requires professional inspection. Hometelligent Inc. provides expert evaluation to accurately determine if a wall is load-bearing before any removal plans are made, ensuring the structural integrity of your home.
